name: FFS_QTS_BUCKET_PROFILE
description: Contains additional configuration parameters for capacity areas.

columns.name: BUCKET_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Uniqueue identifies capacity bucket. It also points to RESOURCE_ID in FFS_RESOURCE where QTS_BUCKET_RESOURCE_ID equal to RESOURCE_ID.

columns.name: QUOTA_FLAGS
columns.description: Bitmask field that defines levels the quota can be defined for.

columns.name: CLOSE_QUOTA_FLAGS
columns.description: Bitmask field that defines levels the quota can be closed on.

columns.name: MAX_CAPACITY_FLAGS
columns.description: Bitmask field that defines levels and a method to estimate the max capacity.

columns.name: AVAILABLE_CAPACITY_FLAGS
columns.description: Bitmask field that defines a logic for the available capacity constraint.

columns.name: DAY_QUOTA_FLAGS
columns.description: Bitmask field that defines a logic for the day level quota.

columns.name: TIME_SLOT_QUOTA_FLAGS
columns.description: Bitmask field that defines a logic for the time slot level quota.

columns.name: CATEGORY_QUOTA_FLAGS
columns.description: Bitmask field that defines a logic for the capacity category level quota.

columns.name: HISTORICAL_DATA_PERIOD
columns.description: Period of time to be used for the historical data analysis.

columns.name: SWITCH_TO_PLANS_DAYS
columns.description: Number of next days after which switch to plans.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: START_THRESHOLD
columns.description: The last part of time slot in percent where we do not suggest booking options.

columns.name: BOOKING_WITH_FORECAST_MIN_DAYS
columns.description: Earliest day for booking with forecasting which is defined by the number of days regarding today.

columns.name: BOOKING_WITH_FORECAST_MAX_DAYS
columns.description: Latest day for booking with forecasting which is defined by the number of days regarding today.
